note: Diagnostic of the v6 Atlantic mass-flux error (scripts/flux_diagnostic.py), values as printed. Labels were regenerated with a different random cbmf spin-up, so the Atlantic worst-level error is 12.3% here vs 11.2% in v6_heldout_tropical_atlantic.json.
conclusion: Not caused by the surface-pressure input (clipping barely helps). Higher surface pressure marks a different regime: more shallow convection (Atlantic flux halves by 860 hPa) than in the Indian Ocean training data, so the emulator lifts 6-9% too much air into the free troposphere. Remedy: more varied training regions.
